notes: Token-only launch of src/LaunchToken.sol:LaunchToken (OpenZeppelin ERC20, Solidity 0.8.26). The token takes no constructor arguments and needs no initialization calls; its constructor mints the whole fixed supply of 10,000,000 DRIM (100000000000000 minor units at 7 decimals) to msg.sender, which is the factory at launch. Every transfer and transferFrom deducts a 5% fee (FEE_BPS = 500, computed as amount / 20 and rounded down in minor units) for the constant FEE_RECIPIENT 0x20a2Fb1bb9e6C1443C11703cCecB3685cd99b7C5; the recipient receives the remaining 95%, total supply is unchanged, and there are no fee exemptions, not even for the factory or the fee recipient. Minting is confined to the constructor; there is no owner, no minter, no pause, no upgrade path, and no privileged wallet. The contracts list is empty, so the factory supplies the LP and MerkleDistributor. The pool pairs with native ETH, has no hook, and uses fee 3000, tickSpacing 60 and initialPrice 79228162514264337593543950336 (decimal sqrtPriceX96 for a 1:1 opening); the pinned policy's initialMarketCapWei overrides this price when present. Verification on the accepted tree: forge build passes and forge test passes 40 tests. The supplied protected checks, run unchanged from test/scratch with IMD_TOKEN_DECIMALS=7, IMD_EXPECTED_SUPPLY=100000000000000 and IMD_PROJECT_COUNT=0, pass 7 of 8. The one failure is TokenProtectedTest.test_transferMovesExactlyWhatItWasAsked, which transfers 100000000000 minor units and expects the recipient to hold that full amount; the accepted token credits 95000000000 to the recipient and 5000000000 to the fee address, exactly as the brief's 5% transfer rule requires. The brief's fee rule and that fee-free check cannot both hold, and no manifest field changes transfer behavior, so this remains an open reconciliation item for the network rather than a defect in the manifest or the token. Fee-on-transfer also affects pool accounting: any liquidity or distributor path that assumes fee-free receipt will see 5% less than it sent. These notes are explanatory only and do not authorize deployment or override policy.
